# mcp-secret-scrub

> Deterministic, no-LLM MCP server that scrubs secrets from text/logs/transcripts before they enter agent context. Redact/mask/hash, never leaks the value.

## When to use
- Before passing raw text/logs/transcripts to an agent or tool that might leak them.
- Before storing logs, transcripts, or debugging output that could contain live credentials.
- Any pipeline that must not let a secret cross into an LLM context or a persisted artifact.

## Key facts
- No LLM. No network. Deterministic. Self-hostable. MIT. Crown-jewel-free.
- Scans NEVER return the secret value — only type, count, position (enforced by test).
- SHA-256 hash mode is reproducible across calls.
- Three modes per call: redact `[REDACTED:TYPE]` / mask (head+tail) / hash.

## Tools (MCP)
- scrub_text(text, mode='redact', keep_label=True) — redact/mask/hash, returns scrubbed text + types scrubbed.
- scan_text(text) — detect secret types present, no mutation.
- report_full(text) — scan + redact in one call with findings.
- secret_profiles() — list supported detection profiles.
